name: 86 Chaos 16.0.19 Schedule Hours Clarity Fix
label: 16.0.19 Schedule Hours Clarity Fix
notes: Scheduled Hours Tracker now explains exactly which shift chips are counted and which OFF/request-off chips are not counted.
Partial-day request-off/availability chips now display with an OFF label so they no longer look like scheduled shifts.
Weekly hour cells include day-by-day math details for counted shifts, invalid time ranges, merged duplicates, and request-off exclusions.
